sections.text:
Ability Power 240. Damages all enemies with magic water damage.
Added effect: Reduces all stats of all enemies by 50% for 60 seconds, casts “Einzebern’s Alchemy” (all stats boosted by 40% and Cost recovery speed increased) on yourself for 50 seconds.
 Level bonus: Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
